owner_rulings_applied.source: Isaac approval decisions, Oct 12 2026 (G2 engineering rulings 1-6)
owner_rulings_applied.invented_distance_data: FORBIDDEN — attempts lacking real kick_distance evidence are excluded from the FG band leg and counted, never imputed
owner_rulings_applied.period_architecture: ONE shared coherent score-generating framework (count components + shared latent + conversions) with SEPARATELY FITTED period-specific parameters per quarter; halves/quarters may NOT inherit full-game probabilities and may NOT use any fixed multiplier (0.50 or otherwise); each period family has its own gate
owner_rulings_applied.evidence_window: Candidate frozen BEFORE evaluation; development on labeled already-exposed 2018-2025; prospective evidence forward-only after a separate activation (NOT part of this attempt); sealed holdout untouched; NO retrospective reconstruction of supposedly historical predictions — development predictions are computed by the frozen runner over historical feature rows and labeled DEVELOPMENT
owner_rulings_applied.gate: Every count target must beat its intercept in >=3 of 5 folds AND pooled (all_targets_must_pass). No threshold reductions, no automatic promotion, no fallback to the exhausted G1 family.
owner_rulings_applied.receipt_format: Immutable source payloads with byte SHA-256, fixture identity, retrieved_at_utc (observation time), origin URI (provenance), parser code SHA-256; source manifest written at fit time records the preregistration commit SHA. (Effective-availability time and correction history apply to forward receipts; development sources are byte-frozen release objects whose availability precedes the whole window.)

carried_verbatim: Touchdown leg: L2-regularized Poisson GLM (log link), heritage design and alpha grid
Rare-score empirical-Bayes construction (prior 25 events) and conversion beta-binomial construction (team-specific at >=50 TDs, prior 25 TDs)
Shared mean-preserving lognormal latent and its out-of-fold residual-product sigma selection
Fold semantics: expanding window, validation seasons 2021-2025, training-fold-only standardization and alpha CV, intercept baseline = training-fold mean
Final score formula 6*TD + PAT + 2*2PT + 3*FG + 2*SAFETY; OT implicit in final counts
materially_new: FG leg: opportunity (attempts) x band-allocation x per-band conversion, five owner-ruled distance bands, in place of every G1 FG construction
Period construction: per-quarter fitted count components within the shared framework (G1 had no period object)
G2 source projection adds kick_distance and period/drive fields under an explicit allowlist

source_contract.objects: The SAME byte-frozen objects as the G1 source contract (nflverse/nfldata games.csv at commit be9813d153e6694af4d98c7287a7db32225806ae, expected sha256 59c8bea7e185dde9e6053a06c24c34f6e5a91dcaea3187c0d9bab12759bb05fb; SportsEdge release nfl-source-freeze-v1 play_by_play_{2018..2025}.csv.gz and depth_charts_{2018..2025}.csv with the expected SHA-256 values recorded in the G1 contract and re-verified before parse)

g2_projection.g2_side_aggregates: G2 allowlist = G1 allowlist PLUS: kick_distance, field_goal_attempt, qtr, drive, yardline_100, fixed_drive, play_type. Market-adjacent fields remain forbidden by the same token screen.

development_window.game_type: REG (heritage builder population: schedule rows for the declared seasons; the heritage feature builder labels rows from PBP presence)
development_window.fold_below_minimum: Attempt is NOT_RUN (data failure), not a fail
development_window.training_per_fold: All rows with season < validation season (expanding window); alpha chosen by expanding-season CV inside the training window only (heritage choose_alpha); standardization training-fold only

feature_policy.heritage_vector: FEATURE_NAMES from sportsedge.sports.nfl.score_counts_g1 (20 features, frozen order), built by the heritage PIT builder: lookback 8 team games, decay 0.85, minimum 4 prior team games, cross-season carry, QB shrinkage prior 100 pseudo-dropbacks / minimum 20 prior dropbacks, starting QB requires the heritage depth-chart PIT selection; rows the heritage builder cannot emit (insufficient history or unresolved QB) are excluded and counted
feature_policy.fg_feature_semantics: Trailing weighted means over the team's prior 8 team games (decay 0.85) of per-game drive-penetration counts computed from byte-bound PBP: a drive is a (game_id, posteam, drive) group of scrimmage plays; RZ trip = drive minimum yardline_100 <= 20; reaching opp 35/25 = drive minimum yardline_100 <= 35 / <= 25. Opponent versions use the opponent's defensive aggregates (drives against them). Strictly before target kickoff; target-game plays forbidden.
feature_policy.period_feature_semantics: Trailing weighted means (8 games, decay 0.85) of the team's per-quarter scoring counts and the opponent's per-quarter allowed counts, from byte-bound PBP quarter aggregates; pregame only, no within-game information
feature_policy.forbidden_inputs: Heritage list verbatim: sportsbook lines/prices, public splits/handle, consensus opinion, postgame or future information, target-game participation to infer the starter, any other model's residuals, post-hoc key-number redistribution

offensive_touchdowns.design: Heritage 20-feature row (own offense + opponent defense flattened by the heritage builder)
offensive_touchdowns.alpha_selection: Heritage choose_alpha expanding-season CV on the training window, metric mean Poisson deviance

opportunity.target: fg_attempts_with_distance (attempts whose kick_distance is present and > 0)
opportunity.family: L2-regularized Poisson GLM (log link) on fg_opportunity_features
opportunity.alpha_selection: Expanding-season CV inside the training window, mean Poisson deviance on the opportunity target

band_allocation.distance_field: kick_distance (nflverse PBP, as recorded; no derivation, no imputation)
band_allocation.team_share_b: (team PIT attempts in band b + 25 * league PIT share b) / (team PIT attempts all bands + 25)
band_allocation.league_share_b: All completed team-games strictly before the target game (heritage full-history PIT semantics, matching the heritage FG make-rate override)

conversion.team_rate_b: (team PIT makes in band b + 25 * league PIT rate b) / (team PIT attempts in band b + 25)
conversion.league_rate_b: Makes / attempts in band b over all completed team-games strictly before the target game

field_goals_banded.gate_target: made_field_goals (ALL realized made FGs in the team-game)
field_goals_banded.exclusions: Attempts with missing or non-positive kick_distance are excluded from shares, rates, and the opportunity target; excluded attempts and any made FGs among them are counted per fold and overall and reported in the result artifact

rare_scores.construction: Heritage per-row PIT empirical-Bayes team rates (def_st_td_rate, safety_rate) carried on heritage rows; league rates from the training window for the artifact fit

conversions.construction: Heritage per-row PIT beta-binomial probabilities (conversion_pat_p, conversion_two_p, conversion_no_p) carried on heritage rows; team-specific only at >=50 prior TDs, prior 25 TDs

shared_latent.sigma_selection: Heritage method: out-of-fold (expanding folds over the development window) predicted TD+FG means; sigma minimizing MSE of (residual product) vs (mu_home * mu_away * (exp(sigma^2) - 1)); ties break to the smaller sigma

period_model.framework: Same count components + shared latent + conversion construction as the full-game model, with parameters fitted SEPARATELY for each quarter q in {1,2,3,4}

per_quarter_legs.offensive_td_q: Poisson ridge (log link) on period_features_per_quarter for q, target = team offensive TDs in quarter q; alpha grid and CV as the TD leg
per_quarter_legs.made_fg_q: Poisson ridge (log link) on period_features_per_quarter for q, target = team made FGs in quarter q (a period-specific direct leg, declared; the banded construction is the full-game FG leg and period families stand on their own fits)
per_quarter_legs.def_st_td_q_and_safety_q: Per-quarter empirical-Bayes team rates (prior 25 events) computed PIT; league per-quarter rates as fallback
per_quarter_legs.conversions_q: Global heritage conversion probabilities applied to quarter TDs (offensive + def/ST) within the same path

period_model.dependence: ONE shared latent draw per simulated path scales TD and FG means in ALL quarters and the full-game legs are a separate path set; quarter draws are conditionally independent given the latent (preregistered period-residual simplification). Halves are sums of their quarters on the same paths.
period_model.second_half_scope: Regulation Q3+Q4 only; overtime points belong to neither half in development scoring. The pricer-side include_ot settlement declaration remains production prerequisite P4 and is NOT resolved by this attempt.
period_model.no_inheritance: Period parameters, gates, and verdicts are independent of the full-game fit; a full-game pass implies nothing for periods

simulation.child_seed_rule: Heritage child_seed construction with the G2 root seed: sha256 of '{root_seed_uint64}:{game_id}' first 8 bytes little-endian (as implemented in the G2 module and recorded in the fit manifest)
simulation.pmf_floor: log score uses p_floor = 0.5 / paths_per_game for any realized score with zero simulated mass

gates.fold_standard: Candidate better than baseline in >=3 of 5 folds AND pooled, unless a gate states otherwise

G_RARE.metric: pooled Poisson log score over all validation rows and folds
G_RARE.standard: candidate pooled log score >= baseline (no-harm), tolerance 1e-12

G_JOINT.metric: mean log score of realized scores under the simulated PMF (50,000 paths, preregistered floor)
G_JOINT.baseline_i: league empirical score PMF from the training window (realized final scores, same floor)
G_JOINT.standard_i: candidate better pooled AND in >=3/5 folds

baseline_ii_frozen_discrete_v2_grid.reason: The frozen discrete_v2 grid requires per-game Attempt-9 margin/total locations. No frozen per-game Attempt-9 location rows exist in the repository for the 2021-2025 development folds (the discrete_v2 evaluation freeze targets a 2026 forward holdout), and re-deriving Attempt-9 locations per fold would create a new fitted object inside this attempt with fold-leakage risk. The leg is recorded, not silently dropped.
baseline_ii_frozen_discrete_v2_grid.preregistered_consequence: G_JOINT verdict is FAIL with reason G_JOINT_BASELINE_II_NOT_RUNNABLE regardless of the baseline-(i) outcome (which is computed and reported for the record). The gate is NOT lowered: a required comparison that cannot be run cannot be passed.

G_CAL.total_pit_slope: Randomized PIT of realized game totals under each game's simulated total CDF (randomization stream: PCG64 seeded from the G2 root seed and the game_id, declared in code); decile reliability slope = OLS slope of observed cumulative fraction vs expected cumulative fraction at decile midpoints 0.05..0.95, pooled over folds; PASS if slope in [0.9, 1.1]
G_CAL.margin_pit_deviation: Randomized PIT of realized margins under simulated margin CDFs; decile histogram frequencies pooled; PASS if max |frequency - 0.1| <= 0.05 (bound fixed here, before scoring)

G_KEY.standard: pooled |model P(margin = k) - realized frequency| <= 0.0075 at EACH key

families.QUARTER: joint (home, away) per-quarter points, pooled over quarters 1-4 (pooled-quarter treatment, declared)

G_PERIOD.metric: mean log score of realized period score pairs under the period simulated PMF (same floor rule)
G_PERIOD.baseline: period league empirical score PMF from the training window
G_PERIOD.standard: per family: candidate better pooled AND in >=3/5 folds
G_PERIOD.inheritance: NONE — period verdicts neither affect nor are affected by the full-game verdict

failure_semantics.implementation_bug_with_frozen_math_unch: Does not consume an attempt; requires a written note in the G2 ledger
failure_semantics.any_change_after_first_scored_run: New attempt consuming budget — NOT authorized in the current task; work stops after attempt 1's evaluation
